Woow MCP management UI — locally bundled typography and icon assets

Poppins 5.2.7 (@fontsource/poppins): SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Outfit 5.2.8 (@fontsource/outfit): SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Noto Sans TC 5.2.9 (@fontsource/noto-sans-tc): SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Yellowtail 5.2.8 (@fontsource/yellowtail): Apache License 2.0 (yellowtail-Apache-2.0.txt).
Copyright (c) 2011 by Brian J. Bonislawsky DBA Astigmatic (AOETI). All rights reserved.
Yellowtail font files are bundled unchanged.
Material Design Icons 7.4.47 (@mdi/font): icon/font licenses as distributed in mdi-LICENSE.txt.

Build copies the complete upstream license texts into dist/licenses alongside the assets.
Fontsource packages distribute upstream fonts; package versions above identify the locked asset packages.
Poppins, Outfit, Yellowtail and Noto Sans TC are the approved free brand font choices, not the proprietary brand fonts.
No official logo asset is supplied or fabricated. The interface heading is plain product text.
No runtime CDN or remote font requests are needed.
